payout_quote: Healthy Overweight Adults, age 18-65 needed. Study number 783808. Dates: Oct 12 2026-Dec 22 2027. Location: Dallas, Texas. Age 18-65. Compensation: $11,964. Referral: $500. ... Check-in: Oct 12, Check-out: Oct 17. Follow up Visits: Oct 20, 27, Nov 3, 10, Dec 22. This is a research study for an investigational drug being developed for the potential treatment of obesity. Dallas, TX is currently recruiting Healthy Overweight Men and Women of Non-Childbearing Potential, ages 18-65. Refer a friend & receive $500 per qualified referral. BMI: 27-40.
steps: Open the Fortrea Clinical Trials studies page and locate Study number 783808 (Dallas, TX — healthy overweight adults).
Call to schedule your screening appointment or apply online.
Pass the screening procedures (vitals, physical exam, ECG, blood samples, drug/alcohol testing) and the eligibility criteria (ages 18-65, BMI 27-40, women must be non-childbearing potential).
Complete the full schedule: check-in Oct 12, check-out Oct 17, and the five follow-up visits (Oct 20, 27, Nov 3, 10, Dec 22).
Receive compensation of $11,964 for time and participation.
catches: Only healthy overweight adults (ages 18-65, BMI 27-40, women must be non-childbearing potential) qualify; you must pass the screening procedures — not everyone qualifies.
This study's check-in is Oct 12, 2026; recruitment is for a specific study group and dates — listings change as studies fill.
Time commitment: a 5-night inpatient stay plus five follow-up visits spanning October-December.
This is a research study for an investigational obesity drug — real medical risks and side effects disclosed in informed consent.
Smokers are allowed for this study, but drug and alcohol testing is part of screening.
biggest_catch: The $11,964 requires a 5-night inpatient stay plus five follow-up visits over three months, passing strict eligibility (BMI 27-40, non-childbearing-potential women, drug/alcohol screening) — and you receive an investigational obesity drug with real side-effect risks.
eligibility: Healthy overweight adults 18-65 in Dallas, TX; BMI 27-40; women must be non-childbearing potential (permanently sterile or postmenopausal); must pass screening.
timing: Compensation paid for time and participation in the clinical study; Fortrea's US terms describe payment via the study's schedule.
